title: Quote builder
description: Turns a customer email asking for parts into a priced draft quote, built from your price list.

spec.output: Draft quote, checks and cover email
spec.whereItRuns: Microsoft 365: Outlook add-in + Power Automate flow

problem: Quote requests arrive as free-text emails with a mix of SKUs, descriptions and loose quantities. A salesperson looks up each item in the price list, checks minimums and volume breaks, and retypes everything into a quote. Items that are not on the list or quantities that are unclear are easy to miss.

steps.label: Input
steps.text: A customer email asking for parts arrives in the shared sales inbox.

steps.label: AI step
steps.text: Claude reads the request and matches each item to the price list, applying minimums and volume breaks.

steps.label: Check
steps.text: Unmatched items, unclear quantities and missing freight details are flagged for a person to review.

steps.label: Output
steps.text: A draft quote and cover email land in Outlook, and the quote moves to the approval step.

stack.name: Claude
stack.role: Reads the request and matches items to the price list.

stack.name: Excel
stack.role: Holds the price list, kept in SharePoint.

stack.name: Outlook
stack.role: Where the request arrives and the draft reply is saved.

stack.name: Power Automate
stack.role: Moves the draft quote into the approval step.

tryIt.placeholder: Paste a customer email asking for parts, with quantities.

samples.label: Pump station cabinets (unlisted item, unclear quantity)
